english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a set of tasks or an assignment.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for a mission or a game task, including a hero's quest when it is framed as a mission.
Use this for an explicitly assigned task, mission, or duty rather than ordinary work in general.
Use 任務 as the all-purpose term for an assigned task outside school.
